https://starrudder.cc/tools/random-name.description: Pick a language and get a full name with a surname, written in its native script and read out loud by your browser.

https://starrudder.cc/zh-Hant/tools/rand.title: 隨機名字產生器 | StarRudder
https://starrudder.cc/zh-Hant/tools/rand.description: 選一個語言，得到以當地文字書寫、含姓氏的完整名字，還能請瀏覽器直接朗讀。

https://starrudder.cc/tools/pixel-avatar.title: Pixel Avatar Maker | StarRudder
https://starrudder.cc/tools/pixel-avatar.description: Pick a pixel-art style, then grow a one-of-a-kind avatar from a shareable seed and export it as a PNG.

https://starrudder.cc/zh-Hant/tools/pixe.title: 像素頭像產生器 | StarRudder
https://starrudder.cc/zh-Hant/tools/pixe.description: 挑一種像素風格，用可分享的 seed 長出獨一無二的頭像，並直接匯出 PNG。

https://starrudder.cc/tools/emoji-wallpa.title: Emoji Wallpaper Maker | StarRudder
https://starrudder.cc/tools/emoji-wallpa.description: Tile a set of emoji into a phone wallpaper, pick the emoji, the arrangement and the aspect ratio, then export it at 4K.

https://starrudder.cc/zh-Hant/tools/emoj.title: Emoji 手機壁紙產生器 | StarRudder
https://starrudder.cc/zh-Hant/tools/emoj.description: 把一組 emoji 鋪成一張手機壁紙，自選 emoji、排列方式與畫面比例，再以 4K 匯出。

https://starrudder.cc/tools/travel-footp.title: Travel Footprint | StarRudder
https://starrudder.cc/tools/travel-footp.description: Set a home point, drop in every place you have been, and let the map draw a route from home to each one. Restyle the lines, then export your map.

https://starrudder.cc/zh-Hant/tools/trav.title: 旅行足跡 | StarRudder
https://starrudder.cc/zh-Hant/tools/trav.description: 設定一個家為起點，把走過的每個地方放上地圖，讓它從家畫出連線。自由調整路線樣式，再把地圖匯出。
